    Make a Google Form

    That's a lot of questions. Forms over 150 questions can take Google too long to build, so consider splitting it into two forms.

    The form is made in your own Google Drive. First time only: Google asks you to allow access. Allow it, then come back here and click Create form again.

    The one-click button isn't connected yet. Use the copy-and-paste option below for now.

    Other way: copy a script into Google
    1. Click Copy script.
    2. Go to script.google.com and click New project.
    3. Delete what's there, paste, and click Run. Allow access when asked.
    4. Your form links show in the Execution log, and the form is in your Google Drive.
